inv.desc_en: INDUSTRIAL WAREHOUSE FOR RENT ON BENJAMIN FRANKLIN. We have an industrial warehouse with 3,850 m2 on the ground floor. Two access doors 5 m high, 2 loading docks, and a fenced outdoor area for shared use. 12-meter height. The property is located in one of the main industrial areas of Zaragoza, with a wide variety of companies from diverse sectors such as logistics, distribution, automotive, and metallurgy, among others. It also has a wide range of services such as restaurants, hotels, and gas stations, making it an important center of economic activity in the city. The industrial estate is located in a central area, with urban bus stops very close by and very close to the communication hubs of the A2, A23, Z40, Ronda Hispanidad, and Avenida Alcalde Caballero. Request information without obligation. Personalized treatment and detailed study of the needs for your business. Visit the property without obligation. We help our clients choose the option that best suits their needs, 35 years of experience in the real estate sector. Information and commercial conditions without contractual validity. Loading Dock: Simplify logistics with our specialized loading dock, designed for a smooth transition between trucks and warehouse, improving productivity and reducing downtime. Lighting: The property is already equipped with lighting to meet your operational needs. Public Transport: Offer convenience to your employees with close access to public transport options. Electrical Installation: Ensure the electrical safety of your operations with a certified installation that complies with all regulations.
